Name: Smooth McGroove Covers--Nature's Crescendo and Moonlight Jellies
Author: DPitSimp
Description:
[size=4][b]Thanks to Smooth McGroove for approving this project! [/b][/size]
[size=4][b][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJvBEEqTaLaKclbCPgIjBSQ]Smooth's Channel[/url] -- [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z9t4rxcdCGQ]Nature's Crescendo Cover[/url] -- [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UvHDHVpJvVc]Moonlight Jellies Cover[/url][/b][/size]

[size=3]This is a simple mod that replaces these two tracks with Smooth's covers of them. Confirmed Crescendo working, have not tested Moonlight Jellies but it should be working. Please notify me if it is not working[/size]

[size=5]Requires Smapi and Content Patcher[/size]
[size=4]Unzip and drag the folder "[CP] Smooth Crescendo and Jellies" into your mod folder[/size]
